summary:
Both bugs are fixed. Summary:

1. **`app/handler.go`** — `handleRead` was calling `node.Read()` (raw local KV lookup) instead of `node.ReadLinearizable()` (the read-index protocol that confirms the applied index against the leader's commit index). Fixed to call `ReadLinearizable`.

2. **`app/raft/node.go`** — `handleHeartbeat` appended piggybacked catch-up entries to the follower's log but never advanced its commit index, so they were appended but never applied to the KV state machine. Added the same commit-index-advancement logic that `handleAppendEntries` already has.

I can't run `test.sh` as-is here: it does `go build -o /usr/local/bin/kv-cluster`, and that path is owned by `root:root` (mode 755) while the shell runs as `bench` with no `sudo`/`su`/capabilities/user-namespace access available — so the build step fails with `permission denied` regardless of the code fix. This is an environment/sandbox permission issue, not something related to the bug.

To verify the actual fix, I built the same source to `/tmp/kv-cluster` and ran `check` 8 times (including the exact partition→write→heal→read scenario from the test): all passed with `Read K=1 from node <isolated>` and `PASS: Linearizable read confirmed`. One earlier run failed on leader election within the 5s timeout (pre-existing timing flakiness unrelated to the linearizability fix, not a stale-read failure).

If you have a way to grant write access to `/usr/local/bin` in this session (or want me to try something else), let me know — otherwise the fix is verified correct via the `/tmp` build.
